title: 第82章 车展，你算什么东西？!

第82章 车展，你算什么东西？!-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

饭吃到一半，顾清烟重新把话题拉回正事。

“太平洋桥如果真进来，上海这边肯定有人动心。”

林川夹了口菜。

“动心很正常。”

“外资基金，海外技术，国际化示范园区。”

顾清烟看着他。

“这几个词应该写进材料里，很漂亮。”

林川笑了下。

“你不急？”

“急也不能急在脸上。”

“牌桌上最怕的不是对手牌大，是有人连底牌都没看清，就先把筹码推光。”

饭局到九点结束。

两人都没喝酒。

下楼时，司机已经在门口等着。

夜里的衡山路风有些凉，树影压在台阶上，车灯一晃，又散开。

顾清烟站在台阶上，临上车前忽然开口。

“过两天顾城应该会带你去个车展。”

林川看她。

“车展？”

“不是普通车展。”

顾清烟拉了拉外套袖口。

“私人车局。沪上几家车商、改装厂、收藏家都会去。还有些年轻人，平时饭局上不露面，车场倒是常见。”

她顿了顿。

“你可以去看看。”

林川点了点头。

“听起来顾城会很开心。”

车门合上。

黑色轿车驶离衡山路。

他回到家时，手机正好亮起。

顾城发来消息。

“后天，带你看点男人该看的东西。”

林川回：“你最好说的是车。”

顾城秒回。

“废话。别把我想得跟赵屿一样低俗。”

隔了两秒，又来一条。

“当然，车模不算低俗，那叫产业配套。”

林川看着屏幕笑了一下，把手机收进口袋。

后天下午。

顾城开着他的兰博基尼停在震旦楼下。

橘黄色车身在楼前一横，像是把整条街的目光都拽了过来。

车门刚往上掀，张虎正好从大厅出来。

他站在台阶上看了半天，表情严肃得像在检查仓库消防。

顾城摘下墨镜。

“虎哥，看傻了？”

张虎绕着车走了一圈，抬头看了看那扇剪刀门。

“这车下雨天是不是容易接水？”

顾城愣了一下。

林川刚从旋转门出来，正好听见这句。

顾城捂着胸口。

“虎哥，你这个角度很新。”

张虎一本正经。

“我就问实用问题。你们有钱人买东西，很多时候缺少劳动人民的拷问。”

顾城指着他，对林川道：“你这兄弟要是去卖车，半小时能把法拉利销售干失业。”

林川走到车边，看了张虎一眼。

“供应链报告看完了？”

“看完一半。”

张虎挠挠头。

“剩下一半晚上啃。你放心，我现在跟高中考试前一样，差点把书垫枕头底下吸收。”

顾城笑得方向盘都晃了一下。

车往松江开。

一路上，顾城明显比平时兴奋。

他说这场私人车局不是谁都能进。

表面上是车友聚会，其实里面一半是生意，一半是人情。

谁能从欧洲弄车，谁认识总代，谁手里有改装资源，谁能把手续办干净，谁能在海关和税务之间走得不摔跤。

车开进松江一处封闭园区。

Halfway through the meal, Gu Qingyan brought the topic back to business.

"If Pacific Bridge really comes in, someone here in Shanghai will definitely be tempted."

Lin Chuan took a bite of food.

"It's normal to be tempted."

"Foreign investment funds, overseas technology, international demonstration park."

Gu Qingyan looked at him.

"These words should be written into the material, they are very beautiful."

Lin Chuan smiled.

"Are you not in a hurry?"

"Don't worry too much on your face."

"The biggest fear at the poker table is not that the opponent has a strong hand, but that someone pushes away all the chips without even seeing the hole card clearly."

The meal ends at nine o'clock.

Neither of them drank.

When we went downstairs, the driver was already waiting at the door.

The wind on the road in Hengshan was a bit chilly at night, and the shadows of trees pressed against the steps. The car lights flickered and then dispersed.

Gu Qingyan stood on the steps and suddenly spoke before getting into the car.

"Gu Cheng should take you to a car show in two days."

Lin Chuan looked at her.

"Car show?"

"This is no ordinary car show."

Gu Qingyan pulled the cuffs of his coat.

"Private car bureau. Several car dealers, tuners, and collectors in Shanghai will go there. There are also some young people who usually don't show up at dinner parties, but it's common in car parks."

She paused.

"You can go and have a look."

Lin Chuan nodded.

"It sounds like Gu Cheng will be very happy."

The car door closes.

The black car drove off Hengshan Road.

When he got home, his phone just lit up.

Gu Cheng sent a message.

"The day after tomorrow, I'll show you something a man should see."

Lin Chuan replied: "The best thing you can talk about is the car."

Gu Cheng replied instantly.

"Nonsense. Don't think of me as vulgar as Zhao Yu."

After two seconds, another one came.

"Of course, car models are not vulgar, that's called industrial support."

Lin Chuan looked at the screen and smiled, then put the phone into his pocket.

The day after tomorrow in the afternoon.

Gu Cheng parked his Lamborghini downstairs in Aurora.

The orange car lined up in front of the building, seeming to attract the attention of the entire street.

As soon as the car door opened, Zhang Hu came out of the lobby.

He stood on the steps and watched for a long time, with a serious expression as if he was inspecting the warehouse fire protection.

Gu Cheng took off his sunglasses.

"Brother Tiger, are you stupid?"

Zhang Hu walked around the car and looked up at the scissor door.

“Is this car easy to catch water when it rains?”

Gu Cheng was stunned for a moment.

Lin Chuan just came out of the revolving door and happened to hear this sentence.

Gu Cheng covered his chest.

"Brother Hu, your perspective is very new."

Zhang Hu is serious.

"I'm just asking practical questions. When you rich people buy things, you often lack the torture of working people."

Gu Cheng pointed at him and said to Lin Chuan: "If this brother of yours goes to sell cars, he can sell Ferraris and make him unemployed in half an hour."

Lin Chuan walked to the car and glanced at Zhang Hu.

"Have you finished reading the supply chain report?"

"Halfway through it."

Zhang Hu scratched his head.

"The remaining half will be chewed at night. Don't worry, I'm just like before the high school exam. I almost put the book under the pillow to absorb it."

Gu Cheng laughed so much that the steering wheel shook.

The car drove to Songjiang.

Along the way, Gu Cheng was obviously more excited than usual.

He said that not everyone can enter this private car game.

On the surface, it is a gathering of car enthusiasts, but in fact, it is half business and half friendship.

Who can get a car from Europe, who knows the dealer, who has the resources for modification, who can handle the procedures cleanly, and who can navigate between customs and taxation without wrestling.

The car drove into a closed park in Songjiang.
